note: 数据来自 silicon-valley.tech（Elon Musk Archive），中文为本站 AI 翻译/整理

items.claim_zh: 特斯拉秘密宏图：先造跑车，再造更便宜的轿车，然后造价格亲民的大众市场车型。
items.claim_en: Tesla's secret master plan: a sports car, then a cheaper sedan, then an affordable mass-market car.
items.quote: Build sports car. Use that money to build an affordable car. Use that money to build an even more affordable car.
items.outcome_zh: 按顺序完成：Roadster（2008年）、Model S（2012年）、Model 3（2017年）。
items.outcome_en: Done in order: Roadster (2008), Model S (2012), Model 3 (2017).
items.source: Tesla blog post “The Secret Tesla Motors Master Plan (just between you and me)”

items.claim_zh: SpaceX将实现轨道火箭助推器的着陆与重复使用。
items.claim_en: SpaceX will land and reuse orbital rocket boosters.
items.outcome_zh: 首次着陆于2015年12月21日；首次复飞于2017年3月30日。如今重复使用已成常态。
items.outcome_en: First landing December 21, 2015; first reflight March 30, 2017. Reuse is now routine.
items.source: Repeated from 2011 onward (National Press Club, AIAA, Falcon Heavy press conference)

items.claim_zh: 猎鹰重型火箭将于2013年首飞。
items.claim_en: Falcon Heavy will make its first flight in 2013.
items.outcome_zh: 首飞于2018年2月6日，晚了约五年。它成功了，两枚侧助推器一同着陆。
items.outcome_en: First flight on February 6, 2018, about five years late. It worked, side boosters landed together.

items.claim_zh: 到2017年底，一辆特斯拉将自行从洛杉矶开到纽约，全程不碰操控装置。
items.claim_en: A Tesla will drive itself from Los Angeles to New York, with no touch of the controls, by the end of 2017.
items.outcome_zh: 从未按宣布的方式实现。特斯拉尚未发布过此类完全无需接管的横跨美国东西海岸驾驶。
items.outcome_en: Never done as announced. Tesla has not published such a fully hands-off coast-to-coast drive.
items.source: Tesla press call announcing Hardware 2, October 2016

items.claim_zh: 到2017年12月，Model 3产量将达到每周5000辆。
items.claim_en: Model 3 production will reach 5,000 cars a week by December 2017.
items.outcome_zh: 于2018年6月最后一周达成，晚了约六个月，此前经历了马斯克所称的“产能地狱”。
items.outcome_en: Reached in the last week of June 2018, about six months late, after what Musk called “production hell”.

items.claim_zh: 2022年首批货运飞船前往火星，2024年首批宇航员前往火星。
items.claim_en: First cargo ships to Mars in 2022, first crew in 2024.
items.outcome_zh: 目前尚无星舰飞往火星。星舰于2023年4月进行了首次完整测试。
items.outcome_en: No Starship has flown to Mars yet. Starship flew its first full test in April 2023.

items.claim_zh: 特斯拉Semi将于2019年投产。
items.claim_en: Tesla Semi production will start in 2019.
items.outcome_zh: 首批交付于2022年12月（百事公司），数量很少；到2026年，大规模量产仍在筹备中。
items.outcome_en: First deliveries in December 2022 (PepsiCo), in small numbers; high-volume production was still being prepared in 2026.

items.claim_zh: 到2020年底，特斯拉可能有100万辆Robotaxi上路。
items.claim_en: Tesla could have a million robotaxis on the road by the end of 2020.
items.quote: This is why it's possible for Tesla to have a million robotaxis by end of 2020 if we upgrade existing HW2 fleet of ~500k & make at least ~500k FSD cars
items.outcome_zh: 2020年没有自动驾驶出租车。特斯拉于2025年6月在奥斯汀推出了小规模付费自动驾驶出租车试点，车上配有安全监控员。
items.outcome_en: No robotaxis in 2020. Tesla launched a small paid robotaxi pilot in Austin in June 2025, with safety monitors on board.

items.claim_zh: 到2019年底，Model 3将在上海超级工厂实现批量生产。
items.claim_en: Model 3 volume production at Gigafactory Shanghai by the end of 2019.
items.quote: By the end of this year, we will -- we expect to be producing Model 3's in volume out of Gigafactory Shanghai
items.outcome_zh: 工厂在不到一年内建成；上海制造的 Model 3 于2019年12月30日首次向客户交付。
items.outcome_en: The factory was built in under a year; first customer deliveries of Shanghai-made Model 3s on December 30, 2019.

items.claim_zh: Model S Plaid将于2020年10月至11月前后投产。
items.claim_en: The Model S Plaid will go into production around October–November 2020.
items.quote: We expect these track times to be beaten by the actual production 7 seat Model S Plaid variant that goes into production around Oct/Nov next year.
items.outcome_zh: 首批交付于2021年6月，晚了约七个月，且为5座版本。
items.outcome_en: First deliveries in June 2021, about seven months late, and in a 5-seat version.

items.claim_zh: 完全自动驾驶（FSD）将在2019年底前实现“功能完备”：车辆能从家开到公司，且很可能无需人工干预。
items.claim_en: Full Self-Driving will be “feature complete” by the end of 2019: the car drives from home to work, most likely without interventions.
items.quote: Feature-complete, I mean, it's -- the car is able to drive from one's house to work, most likely without interventions. So it will still be supervised...
items.outcome_zh: FSD Beta 于2020年10月首次推送给一批车主。截至2026年，它仍以“FSD（监督版）”销售：驾驶员必须保持专注。
items.outcome_en: FSD Beta reached a first group of owners in October 2020. As of 2026 it is still sold as “FSD (Supervised)”: the driver must stay attentive.

items.claim_zh: Cybertruck将于2021年末开始生产。
items.claim_en: Cybertruck production will start in late 2021.
items.outcome_zh: 首批交付于2023年11月30日，晚了两年。
items.outcome_en: First deliveries on November 30, 2023, two years late.

items.claim_zh: Neuralink最早可能在2020年进行人体植入。
items.claim_en: Neuralink may implant a human as soon as 2020.
items.quote: Neuralink may have this in a human as soon as this year.
items.outcome_zh: 2021年再次重申（“今年晚些时候”）。首次人体植入于2024年1月（诺兰·阿博）。
items.outcome_en: Repeated in 2021 (“later this year”). First human implant in January 2024 (Noland Arbaugh).

items.claim_zh: 到2020年4月底，美国的新冠新增病例将接近零。
items.claim_en: Close to zero new COVID-19 cases in the US by the end of April 2020.
items.quote: Based on current trends, probably close to zero new cases in US too by end of April
items.outcome_zh: 2020年4月底，美国每天仍记录约2.5万至3万例新增病例。
items.outcome_en: The US was still recording around 25,000 to 30,000 new cases a day at the end of April 2020.

items.claim_zh: SpaceX计划在2021年完成48次发射。
items.claim_en: SpaceX aims for 48 launches in 2021.
items.quote: We will need to make a lot of improvements to have a chance of completing 48 launches next year!
items.outcome_zh: SpaceX 在2021年执行了31次猎鹰9号任务。随后发射频率激增：2022年61次，2023年96次。
items.outcome_en: SpaceX flew 31 Falcon 9 missions in 2021. The cadence then exploded: 61 in 2022, 96 in 2023.

items.claim_zh: 2022年的两大主要目标：星舰入轨，以及FSD广泛发布。
items.claim_en: Two main goals for 2022: Starship to orbit and a wide release of FSD.
items.quote: 2 main goals this year: - Starship to orbit - FSD wide release
items.outcome_zh: 星舰的首次完整飞行于2023年4月进行，以爆炸告终；它于2024年3月沿接近轨道的路径进入太空。FSD Beta 于2022年11月向所有北美买家开放。
items.outcome_en: Starship's first full flight came in April 2023 and ended in an explosion; it reached space on a near-orbital path in March 2024. FSD Beta opened to all North American buyers in November 2022.

items.claim_zh: AI到2025年很可能比任何单个人类更聪明，到2029年比所有人类加起来更聪明。
items.claim_en: AI will probably be smarter than any single human in 2025, and smarter than all humans combined by 2029.
items.quote: AI will probably be smarter than any single human next year. By 2029, AI is probably smarter than all humans combined.
items.outcome_zh: 尚不存在公认的测试。2026年1月，他将首个里程碑改到“今年年底……不迟于明年”。
items.outcome_en: No agreed test exists. In January 2026 he moved the first milestone to “the end of this year… no later than next year”.

items.claim_zh: DOGE能从美国联邦预算中削减至少2万亿美元。
items.claim_en: DOGE can cut at least $2 trillion from the US federal budget.
items.outcome_zh: 马斯克将目标下调至1万亿美元，随后降至1500亿美元。DOGE 自己的网站声称到2025年中期节省了不到2000亿美元；独立审查发现其中许多说法被夸大。
items.outcome_en: Musk lowered the target to $1 trillion, then $150 billion. DOGE's own website claimed savings of under $200 billion by mid-2025; independent reviews found many of those claims overstated.
items.source: Trump rally at Madison Square Garden, October 2024

items.claim_zh: 多艘星舰将在2026年火星转移窗口飞往火星。
items.claim_en: Many Starships will go to Mars in the 2026 transfer window.
items.quote: Many Starships will go to Mars in 2 years, when the transit window opens again.
items.outcome_zh: 2026年窗口现已开启。尚未有结果。
items.outcome_en: The 2026 window is open now. Not resolved yet.

items.claim_zh: 星舰将于2026年底携带Optimus机器人启程前往火星；人类登陆最早在2029年，更可能在2031年。
items.claim_en: Starship will leave for Mars at the end of 2026, carrying Optimus robots; human landings as soon as 2029, more likely 2031.
items.quote: Starship departs for Mars at the end of next year, carrying Optimus. If those landings go well, then human landings may start as soon as 2029, although 2031 is more likely.
items.outcome_zh: 火星发射窗口于2026年末开启。尚未有结果。
items.outcome_en: The Mars launch window opens in late 2026. Not resolved yet.

items.claim_zh: 2026年下半年将有数百万辆特斯拉完全自动驾驶运行。
items.claim_en: Millions of Teslas operating fully autonomously in the second half of 2026.
items.quote: I predict that there'll be millions of Teslas operating fully autonomously in the second half of next year.
items.outcome_zh: 截止期限为2026年底。尚未有结果。
items.outcome_en: Deadline is the end of 2026. Not resolved yet.

items.claim_zh: 到2026年底，AI将比任何人类都聪明，最迟不晚于2027年。
items.claim_en: AI smarter than any human by the end of 2026, no later than 2027.
items.quote: I think we might have AI that is smarter than any human by the end of this year. And I would say no later than next year.
items.outcome_zh: 尚未有结果。
items.outcome_en: Not resolved yet.
